title: StoryCraft Modpack
description: Modpack for original youtube series by jheyvu - StoryCraft. For jehyvu's community fun playing.
body:
![Logo of project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d4629a4da184bed43bcd1ad22f686a87f33667c.png)
# StoryCraft by Jheyvu
is a modpack for single player playing. It's based on YouTube singleplayer series. 

## A lot of new content! 
Modpack adds a lot of new expierience with Vanilla style.
**You can find in this:** 
- Visual and Sounds improvements
- New mobs
- New structures
- A lot of decorations for your new buildings 
- Optimizations mods
- Ready to play config
- Shaders and textures
